cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. His original diagram is in the constitution. My bow follows that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you have a signed exception. I'll bow on behalf of everyone still governed by the constitution.

mechanism: Misread a bent colleague as a ceremonial bow, then compete to make the copied gesture an official precedent.
confusable: Not mere traditionalism: B2 must reveal an ordinary action mistaken for ceremony, and A3 must refuse to acknowledge that error.
comparison: Embodied ceremony and photographic precedent contrast with rota documentation.
seedUse: Uses canonical founder/bow legitimacy contest, replaces constitutional diagram with copied programme pickup and a photograph.
